title: GenAI Evaluation Case
description: Schema for one golden evaluation case used to evaluate the GenAI RAG pipeline.

question.description: The user question sent to the RAG system.

expected_source_ids.description: Source document IDs expected to support the answer.

answerability.description: Whether the question can be reliably answered from the available corpus.

expected_facts.description: Optional facts that should appear or be supported by the answer.

answer_notes.description: Optional evaluator notes describing what a good answer should contain.
